packageRules.description: Auto-merge minor, patch, digest and digest-pin updates for everything

No release-age gate on digests. They track mutable tags that get rebuilt upstream, which resets the age clock every run, so renovate/stability-days hangs pending forever and the branch is never green.

GHCR/Quay return no release timestamps, so timestamp-required hangs pending forever (#404, #410, #411 stuck 3+ weeks). Gate by cadence instead: Wed PR, Sat merge = 3 day soak, weekend free to fix breakage.
Always auto-merge (including major) for selected apps
Critical infra: hold minor updates for the weekend so I have time to fix breakage. Patch releases are left to merge as soon as they are green.
Never auto-merge the Meilisearch search DB used by Linkwarden
Never auto-merge the Proxmox Terraform provider
Rook Ceph storage charts: minor and major land as manual PRs so I can review CRD and OSD changes first
Exception: Ceph patch releases are bugfix-only and safe to auto-merge

Never auto-merge the snapshot controller: its image version must stay in step with the vendored CRDs in k8s/snapshot-controller/, which Renovate cannot bump. Merging alone would create skew — re-vendor the manifests in the same PR.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Dependabot alerts on, security updates off (they would compete with Renovate). Covers .github/workflows only: GHSA has no container or Helm ecosystem.
